media.title: Professional portrait
media.reviewReceipt: Owner supplied this portrait in chat and asked on 2026-11-01 for a more professional finish. Lossless EXIF and IPTC removal, then mild global levels, contrast, colour and sharpening only; no retouching, reshaping or background change. Full square framing kept. Source SHA-256 d49e798332bcc736281f822cc75ed1f0bbb12ea4474dcfb97f7cde2019a64898 was already the site portrait's decoded image. Identity and publication permission are owner-attested.

media.title: Standard CV
media.reviewReceipt: Owner supplied a new CV in chat on 2026-11-01 and asked for it to be published, replacing the previous CV. Original SHA-256 bf38be6ddfabe3490db5bc2073fd58e8c6e5398b4c607893bb826d88b7f48a42. The phone number was removed from the page text itself (not covered), the email link was realigned, and the document title was changed from an employer-specific title to a neutral one. Render, extracted text, document info, XMP and link annotations inspected: no phone, home address, private local path, executable action or nested source PDF. Claims are owner-provided; project output counts are not independently audited publications.
